rationale: The description gives sales-conversion, live-engagement and online-experience outcomes and calls the offering a conversational sales platform, but does not describe what the conversation function entails. Non-AI is the best-supported forced choice, with weak evidence.
evidence_spans: increase sales conversion, improve live engagement and provide a differentiating online customer experience.
conflict_response: The wording does not say whether conversations are human-led, automated, or AI-mediated, so I infer none of those mechanisms. These outcomes and category phrase do not affirm AI, but are too vague to support a confident conventional-functionality negative.
